notes.text: Creativity doesn't always come from inspiration. Sometimes it comes from showing up consistently.
I've been thinking about how discipline might be the foundation of creative work.
Forcing myself to sit at the piano each morning produces melodies even when I feel uninspired.
I want to protect a daily block for deep work by switching off email and chat.
Spending the first hour at my desk without messages leaves room for difficult thinking.

For the Atlas release, fixing checkout reliability matters more than shipping extra features.
Priya told me her garden tomatoes are ripening early this summer.
I might apply for a software engineering internship at Northstar, but I am worried that my portfolio is too small. I have not decided.
Before applying to Northstar's software engineering internship, I want to finish one portfolio project to show my practical experience.

cases.review: Specific connection between regular practice and creative work, no claim about current feelings.
Conceptual match to focused work despite different wording; no generic work association.
Actual Atlas checkout tradeoff, not shared person name alone.
Keeps internship/application speculative; never claims acceptance or completed application.
Simple reminder gets no forced related thought, including another shopping list.
Insufficient meaning produces no invented connection.
Transcribed book idea relates by meaning; same book title alone is insufficient.
Audio-derived wording uses the same pipeline and is grounded in habitual creative practice.
